description: Election Commission - Mr. M. S. M. Jawfer of the Eravurpattu Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of Member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Eravurpattu Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content falls under electoral processes and matters related to local authority elections, specifically addressing the vacation of an elected office, which aligns with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as defined by "Electoral commission appointments and decisions" and matters related to elected officials' status.
